stem: Each prescription below is for doxycycline intended for an untreated sex partner who has not been examined. Which scenarios fit the Massachusetts pharmacy EPT policy's diagnosis scope? Select all that apply.

choices.text: The index patient has chlamydia and the partner prescription uses an accepted EPT designation
The index patient has chlamydia and the partner is named on the separate prescription
The index patient has gonorrhea only and the prescription relies solely on Policy 2020-08
The index patient has syphilis only and the prescription relies solely on Policy 2020-08
The index patient has confirmed chlamydia and a separate partner prescription is issued

explanation.core_reasoning: Under this Massachusetts pharmacy policy, doxycycline can follow EPT only when the chlamydia EPT pathway is actually triggered.

choice_analysis.A: That remains within the chlamydia pathway.
choice_analysis.D: That diagnosis is outside this EPT policy.

related_facts: The drug name alone does not establish EPT eligibility.
explanation.mpje_trap: Assuming an antibiotic commonly used for STIs makes every STI an EPT case.
